releaseNotesKm: ផ្ទាំងទិដ្ឋភាពសប្តាហ៍ថ្មី។ អេក្រង់រៀបចំផ្ទាំងដើមដោយឡែក មានគំរូ ការអូស និងព្រួញ។ ចុចឱ្យយូរលើផ្ទាំងណាមួយដើម្បីលាក់ ឬផ្លាស់ទី។
releaseNotesEn: The week as seven bars, so you can see which day is going to be busy before you get there. A dashboard editor of its own with four presets, drag-to-reorder and the arrows kept beside it, and a long press on any module to hide or move it without leaving the screen. The header greets you and sheds two lines as you scroll.
